fonte_original: ONS - Balanço de Energia nos Subsistemas (horário), dataset balanco_energia_subsistema_ho
query: SELECT subsystem_code, subsystem_name, is_national_aggregate, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', reference_month) AS reference_month, hours_count, hours_with_null_generation, hydro_gwh, thermal_gwh, wind_gwh, solar_gwh, load_gwh, total_generation_gwh FROM `ons-energy-pipeline.dbt_dev.mart_ons__monthly_generation_by_source` ORDER BY reference_month, subsystem_code
